drawings.description: moitié supérieure du feuillet, quatre rangées de figures (complexes cellulaires esquissés). Première rangée : trois segments portant trois, quatre puis cinq marques de subdivision (extrémités comprises). Deuxième rangée : un petit rectangle divisé en deux ; une amande hachurée coupée par son grand axe ; deux amandes hachurées accolées par une pointe, avec dessous un petit rectangle divisé en deux. Troisième rangée : une bande verticale de trois carrés ; une amande hachurée fermée en dessous par un second arc (un disque à deux étages) ; trois amandes hachurées accolées en chaîne, la première raturée en son milieu, avec dessous un rectangle divisé en trois. Quatrième rangée : un huit (deux cercles tangents en un point) traversé par une horizontale, et un petit carré divisé en quatre. Deux longues courbes séparent les groupes.
drawings.kind: rows of sketched cell complexes: subdivided segments, hatched almonds, divided squares, a figure of eight
drawings.notes: All the figures of the upper half of the sheet, each redrawn at its place: three segments with 3, 4 and 5 subdivision marks (ends included; each mark computed on its segment); the small rectangle cut in two; the hatched almond with its long axis; the pair of hatched almonds sharing one tip (drawn through the same point), with the small rectangle cut in two under them; the vertical strip of three squares; the almond with a second arc below it, hatched; the chain of three hatched almonds, consecutive ones sharing a tip, with the rectangle cut in three under them; the figure of eight (two circles through one common point) with the horizontal line through that point; the small square cut in four; the two long curves that separate the groups. Left out: the scribble that strikes the middle of the first almond of the chain (struck material). Still differs: the almonds and their hatching are regularised (his hatching strokes are free, 3 to 5 per almond); the two separating curves are smooth curves through points read on the crop. Disagreement in part with the note of the transcription, which counts « deux, trois puis quatre marques de subdivision »: the three segments carry 3, 4 and 5 marks counting their ends (1, 2 and 3 inner marks). Overlaid on the 400 dpi colour facsimile on 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5): every figure lies on the page within about 1 mm; not changed. What is listed above as regularised still is. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, overlay check (issue 147): laid over the scan rendered at 350 dpi in colour; not compiled (no TeX engine in the session), the TikZ was rasterised by a script; nothing changed. The segments, rectangles, the strip of squares, the small square cut in four, the outlines of the almonds and the two separating curves lie on their ink within about 1 unit. Kept partial for what is still regularised: the hatching of the almonds and of the disc is drawn as even strokes, not his free strokes (3 to 5 an almond, at their own slants); the second arc under the almond of the third row ends lower than his; the two circles of the figure of eight are drawn round where his are slightly flattened (up to 1 unit off at the bottom).

drawings.description: dos d'enveloppe, une vingtaine de figures (complexes cellulaires esquissés) autour des formules. En haut au milieu : un segment à deux extrémités marquées avec une flèche descendante, un segment à trois points, un segment à quatre points, une amande à deux sommets avec une flèche montante. En haut à droite : un petit ovale à un sommet et un ovale à deux sommets, chacun avec une flèche descendante ; au-dessous un disque hachuré coupé par un diamètre et deux amandes hachurées accolées ; puis une sphère avec son équateur, un arc, deux carrés superposés, deux carrés accolés. Au milieu à droite : une bande verticale de trois carrés, une bande horizontale de trois carrés repassée d'un trait épais, un axe gradué de quatre marques partant d'un trait vertical, un carré divisé en quatre aux côtés courbes, un petit segment. En bas : à gauche deux amandes accolées, chacune coupée par son axe ; un quadrillage de trois sur trois, repassé d'un trait épais, avec de petites flèches ; une chaîne de quatre amandes de taille décroissante, chacune coupée par son axe, avec de petites flèches descendantes ; au-dessus une chaîne de quatre flèches horizontales partant du sommet d'une flèche verticale descendante.
drawings.kind: page of sketched cell complexes: segments, almonds, squares, grids, chains of arrows
drawings.notes: Each figure is redrawn at its place, in a regularised form: segments with their marked points computed on them; almonds as two arcs through the same two tips, consecutive almonds of a chain sharing a tip; strips and grids of squares as rectangles with their dividing lines; the hatched disc and the two hatched almonds with a few hatching strokes; the sphere as a circle with a flat almond for its equator; the two chains of arrows. Left out: all formulas and words (the transcription gives them), the typed address of the envelope, the typescript showing through, the small arrows inside the cells of the 3 by 3 grid and of the chain of four almonds (their directions are not all legible: mostly downwards, some to the right along the top of the grid). Still differs: sizes and positions are read off a wide crop (1 to 2 units); curved sides (the square cut in four, the envelope-shaped almonds) are straightened or smoothed; heavy overdrawing is rendered by one heavy line. Overlaid on the 400 dpi colour facsimile on 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) and corrected: the chain of four at the foot (left of « Δn × Δn' ») is not a chain of almonds with an axis: each of its four cells is drawn like the sphere at the top, a rounded outline (top and bottom arcs through the shared tips) with a flat almond inside (two arcs just under the line of the tips); redrawn so, the straight axes removed. The other figures lie on the page within 1 to 2 mm. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, overlay check (issue 147): the envelope laid over the scan rendered at 350 dpi in colour; not compiled (no TeX engine in the session), the TikZ was rasterised by a script; nothing changed. The figures stand at their places within 1 to 2 units. Kept partial: the 3 by 3 grid at the foot is drawn as a regular square grid, while his is skewed (columns leaning left), overdrawn with heavy strokes and carries small arrows in its cells (left out); the chain of four cells beside it and the large almond at the top left are 1 to 2 units off in places; the curved sides of the square cut in four and of the envelope-shaped almonds are smoothed; heavy overdrawing is one heavy line. The typed address on the envelope (the addressee is Grothendieck himself) is not drawn.

drawings.description: moitié droite du feuillet, six figures : en haut, un prisme oblique à faces hachurées posé sur un quadrillage de quatre colonnes et trois rangées ; un segment aux extrémités marquées ; un rectangle ouvert à droite, ses côtés haut et bas épaissis ; un carré aux quatre sommets marqués ; un cylindre dont la base est une amande hachurée à deux sommets ; plus bas, un carré divisé en quatre.
drawings.kind: prism on a grid, segment, open rectangle, square, cylinder with an almond base, square cut in four
drawings.notes: Top: the grid (four columns, three rows) with its heavy oblique hatching strokes, one per column, and above it the slab drawn in perspective: five oblique edges rising to the right from the top of the grid, the top edge, the right-hand vertical and the oblique edge closing the right side. Then the segment with its two end marks; the rectangle open at the right (top and bottom sides heavy); the square with its four marked corners (left and top sides heavy); the cylinder: top rim as two arcs, two sides, and the base as an almond between two marked points, hatched with vertical strokes; and, lower on the sheet, the square cut in four. Left out: the formulas between the figures and the typescript showing through. Still differs: the prism is a crowded perspective sketch; its strokes are regularised and the inner rectangle drawn on its top face is omitted; the note of the transcription counts four figures (prism, square, cylinder, square cut in four): the segment and the open rectangle are added here. Overlaid on the 400 dpi colour facsimile on 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) and corrected: the square cut in four at the foot was drawn 2 to 3 mm too low at its top and middle lines; redrawn from the page: its top line stops short of the upper right corner (the right side starts lower), the middle line stands at mid-height, the dividing vertical runs a little past the top and bottom. The other figures lie on the page within 1 to 2 mm; the prism stays as described above. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again. 2026-11-13, Claude Opus 5.5, overlay check (issue 147): laid over the scan rendered at 350 dpi in colour; not compiled (no TeX engine in the session), the TikZ was rasterised by a script; nothing changed. The segment, the open rectangle, the square with its four marked corners, the cylinder and the square cut in four lie on their ink within about 1 to 2 units. Kept partial for the prism: its base grid is drawn as a regular rectangular grid where his is a skewed parallelogram with lines running past it, its hatching strokes and receding edges are regularised (1 to 3 units off), and the inner rectangle of its top face is omitted.

drawings.description: à gauche de « $\pi_0(F_*, x) = \ldots$ », un lacet : une boucle qui part du point marqué $x$ et y revient, fléchée.
drawings.kind: loop based at the point x
drawings.notes: As on the page: the point x with its letter, and a loop leaving it to the lower right and coming back from above, with its arrowhead at the point. Nothing struck. Overlaid on the 400 dpi colour facsimile on 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5): the loop and its arrowhead lie on the page within about 1 mm (the page has no heavy dot: the vertex is the end of the short stroke leaving the letter x); not changed. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
